text_block_list.text:
Training with Verxina was progressing, 
albeit slowly. She puts on a brave front, 
but...
choice_data_list:
(She's pushing herself too hard, isn't 
she...)

(She's pushing herself too hard, isn't 
she...)

text_block_list.text:
To confront the "weakness" Verxina had 
shown... I set aside some time for us to 
have a thorough discussion.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Back then... Well, I made an utter fool of 
myself—
choice_data_list:
I'm the one who should apologize for 
making you push yourself alone.

No, I'm the one who should be sorry for 
making you push yourself alone.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Please, let me fight alongside you this 
time!
Let me fight alongside you this time!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...You said the same thing to me before, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It was my own problem, so I wanted to 
handle it by myself first. But...
choice_data_list:
...Alright! First things first, let's take 
a walk.

...Alright! First things first, let's take 
a walk.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

At any rate, easing her troubled mind was 
the top priority. So, we decided to take a 
change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You see that walkway in the distance? I 
ran there with Cheval early in the morning 
once before.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Cheval uncharacteristically agreed to it. 
Something must have given her confidence. 
She even talked a bit while we were 
running..."

After that, everywhere they went, Verxina 
spoke of nothing but memories of her 
younger sisters—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And so, Vivlos kept staring so intensely 
that I gave her a bite of my ice cream. 
But then...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she was bawling! It was so cold all of 
a sudden, it must have startled her.
choice_data_list: Haha, how adorable.
Haha, how adorable.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right? Cheval and I did our best to 
comfort them—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—That day was my very first victory. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos and Cheval made a beautiful flower 
crown for me. They said, "It's perfect for 
our cool big sis."
choice_data_list:
Is that why you're aiming for the Triple 
Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I felt that a floral 
crown-like... tiara would suit me best.
choice_data_list:
Your little sisters really are your 
driving force, aren't they?

Your little sisters really are your reason 
for running, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I betrayed those girls' 
expectations...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: (H-handkerchief, handkerchief...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I want a hug.

That word catches me off guard. Looking 
back on everything until now, something 
comes to mind.
choice_data_list: (Does that mean, could it be...—)

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Why not! Let's show everyone how close we 
are! Everyone! "Papa Hug"!

"What she needs right now... might be the 
warmth of her family, which means so much 
to her. In that case—"
choice_data_list:
Verxina. Let's go home, back to our family 
home!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Verxina-chan! Welcome to you 
too, Trainer-san~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You two... Why did you come all of a 
sudden? What about work?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"I just happened to have the day off! I'm 
free all day today!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's just a coincidence.
It's just a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

"Verxina looks around at her parents' 
faces and smiles. Just that alone causes 
her expression to instantly brighten 
up..."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Over here, Verxina. Today, you 
get me all to yourself!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
choice_data_list: ...May I use the restroom?!

text_block_list.text:
When I returned a short while later, 
Verxina's expression had softened. It 
seemed she had managed to calm down.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Verxina-chan. Want to go out 
somewhere with me sometime?"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
An amusement park! Let's go—all together! 
It's been so long!
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Wanna ride on that flying thing? You 
used to love them, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
! That's right, let's go! That one was a 
three-seater, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's all have lots of fun today♪ Over 
this way~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Cheva-chi! Now's the time, right 
now!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... ugh... R-Really...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —S-Should I feed it to her...?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~! It's a huge success, Cheval-chi, so 
cute, so cuteâª

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... N-Never mind, forget I said 
anything...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ... ...Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ah! How nostalgic~♪ Do you remember that 
ship monument?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I remember! We all took a photo together, 
right? Chevalchi was crying for some 
reason~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huuuh!? N-No way, that's not true...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Since we're here, want to take a 
picture together to commemorate it?
choice_data_list: I'll take the picture!
I'll take the photo.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer-san, I look forward to 
working with you!
choice_data_list: Here we go, say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheese!

And so, our lively family refresh time 
passed by—

Surrounded by her family's love, Verxina 
began showing genuine smiles from the 
bottom of her heart. If I can learn more 
about her roots, then surely—
choice_data_list: Um! Mother, I have a small favor to ask—

text_block_list.text:
The next day, my mother had a package 
delivered to me. When I opened it together 
with Verxina, inside was... a treasure 
trove filled with "history."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"So nostalgic...! This is the very first 
magazine my family and I were featured 
in."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"We were invited for a special feature on 
'Celebrity Families'... and the three of 
us sisters wore matching dresses."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh? This photo album...! I feel like I 
remember seeing this a long time ago...?

After getting permission from a slightly 
bashful Verxina, I open the album. And the 
first page reveals—
choice_data_list: (Verxina as a baby...!)

text_block_list.text:
"Like an angel" would be the most fitting 
description. And in those lively eyes, I 
could catch a glimpse of how she looks 
today...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't stare at it so closely. 
Look, there are plenty more pages ahead...

Verxina blinks in wonder. What she was 
gazing at was a slightly more mature 
version of herself, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I seem to be... spaced out quite a 
bit, don't I?"
choice_data_list: Look, Mom's comment too...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Were there any comments...? No, I 
completely forgot about them...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Verxina is as laid-back as ever. Even 
while the other kids play outside, she 
couldn't care less... I wonder if she'll 
just keep growing at her own leisurely 
pace?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The next one is... 'This child is very 
self-paced. Doesn't seem interested in 
playing or getting attention...' ...is 
what the teacher said. That's a little 
sad~"
choice_data_list:
Looking at you now, I can't even imagine 
it.
I can't imagine that from how you are now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I'm sure Cheval will appear 
starting from the next page!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
When she was a baby, she was just like a 
little mochi! Of course, she's still 
adorable now, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah...

In the photo she was gazing at... a plump 
little Cheval Grand was being held by an 
equally small Verxina—

She held it dearly. From that page on, 
family photos with Vivlos increased too... 
The expression on Verxina's face in them 
was—
choice_data_list:
...You've completely got the look of an 
'older sister' now, huh.

...You've completely got the look of an 
'older sister' now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...
choice_data_list:
Your little sisters were born, and that's 
how you became who you are now, huh.

Ever since your little sisters were born, 
you've become the person you are today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...So it was the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Those children raised me... and made me 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"And once again... everyone has lent me 
their strength, haven't they?"
choice_data_list: Ah, you... You all will be alright
Yeah, you... "you guys" will be fine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: We... together?

As the eldest sister, Verxina had 
struggled to lead her sisters all by 
herself. But in her family, there's no 
need for any one person to shoulder the 
burden alone.

Parents caring for children... children 
caring for parents. As older sisters, as 
younger sisters... People who hold each 
other dear have gathered here.
choice_data_list:
You are a family filled with love. And 
that's why—

You are a family filled with love. That's 
why—

text_block_list.text:
Even if someone comes to a halt before a 
massive wall... she will always gently 
envelop them and urge them forward—
choice_data_list:
You can start walking toward the top once 
more.

You can start walking toward the summit 
once more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I need to... become a 'big sister' 
once again."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No... I want to be an older sister. I want 
to stay ahead of those girls...!
choice_data_list:
(She's back... In that case, now is the 
time—)

text_block_list.text:
Those words had undoubtedly become a heavy 
burden for her. But now... they were magic 
words that could give her strength once 
more—
choice_data_list:
You can do it. After all, you're the "big 
sister," right?

You can do it. After all, you're the "big 
sister," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"‘Don't worry, Mama. I'll take good care 
of Cheval and Verxina!’"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I'll definitely protect 
you. After all—I'm your big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! About the training starting 
tomorrow, back toâ

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, please make it even more intense than 
before!
choice_data_list: Verxina...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry. But... I'm 
all right now!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because I've realized... that I will never 
truly be broken in the real sense.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm no longer afraid to come to a halt. 
Please let me challenge it—as many times 
as it takes!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —In order to stand at the top!
